messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] slo_burn(alert_id=RBW-9234) service=api-gateway region=us-west1 burn_rate=4.2x window=1h paging_policy=multi-window => page: #incidents
Maya Patel: Ack'd, I'm on it. Opening the burn dashboard https://redwood.monitor/d/pgw?panelId=7 :eyes:
Liam Chen: pulling logs now, tailing dispatch + kvcache. suspecting recent batching change causing KV thrash
Andre Gomez: can you paste the alert query? want to correlate with autoscaler events
Maya Patel: alert query in cloudwatch: `sum(rate(slo_burn[5m])) / slo_budget` — will paste full query in ticket
Liam Chen: quick grep shows a spike in cache misses around 13:59 UTC — many retries + increased latency
Maya Patel: customer impact: ~12 5xxs in 10m, top customers hit: acct-732, acct-198, acct-900 (CSM pinged). Not widespread but visible to key accounts
SRE-Runbook-Bot: Suggested runbook: /runbooks/api-gateway/burnrate-debug steps: verify cache, restart pool, check routing fallbacks
Maya Patel: Performing step 2: restarting worker pool pool-gateway-2 (cmd: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-pool-2`)
Sofia Ruiz: FYI I checked deploys — rollout 2026-03-15T13:45 added batching v2 with experimental KV prefetch disabled
Maya Patel: After restart, 10m burn dropped to ~2.8x. still over SLO threshold but improving
Liam Chen: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z ERROR kvcache: miss key=abc123 latency=120ms
2026-03-15T14:02:20Z ERROR dispatch: request timed out after 250ms
```
Andre Gomez: i'm leaning towards transient cache miss storm + longer tails from batch change. we should avoid immediate thesis-level alert changes unless we harden criteria
Maya Patel: ops decision needed: keep paging on or dampen to avoid repeated noise? proposal below
Liam Chen: proposal: switch SLO burn alert to multi-window policy: require both short window spike AND elevated 1h baseline to page. e.g. 5m >= 3.0x AND 1h >= 1.5x before paging. reduces chatter from short transient bursts
Maya Patel: example rule (temp):
```yaml
alerts:
  - name: slo_burn_multiwindow
    windows:
      - short: 5m
      - long: 1h
    thresholds:
      short: 3.0
      long: 1.5
    paging: true
```
Maya Patel: for immediate noise control i recommend muting 5m page alerts for 10m while we stabilize and open a config PR to implement the multi-window rule
OpsLead Jun: +1 to mute for 10m but also add a temporary fallback routing: route low-priority traffic to smaller shard to reduce pressure. don't want customer-visible failures
Andre Gomez: I'll open GH issue redwood/observability#452 with alert query, sample grafana panels, and proposed thresholds. assigning to @Liam and @Sofia for review
Sofia Ruiz: i'll add a small dashboard panel: "SLO burn vs traffic" and "kvcache hit ratio" - will target a hotfix panel within 30m
Maya Patel: logging mitigation and customer comms in INC-20260315-41. CSMs already notified top 3 customers, no escalation yet :white_check_mark:
Liam Chen: follow-up idea: Redwood Optimize should recommend model-shard/quantization fallback when cache miss > 30% to reduce per-token compute during pressure
Maya Patel: tasks captured: 1) implement multi-window alert rule PR (Andre) 2) temporary mute 5m page for 10m (Maya) 3) dashboard widget + retention tweak (Sofia) 4) runbook update to include multi-window policy + paging criteria (Liam)
SRE-Runbook-Bot: automation note: monitoring shows burn_rate trending to 1.15x over 30m after pool restart
Maya Patel: will keep the page open for 20 more minutes; close if stable. tagging reactions :eyes: :thumbsup: :white_check_mark:
Andre Gomez: starting config PR now, will include unit tests for alert windows and doc in observability/alerts/README.md
Liam Chen: i'll prepare a short incident summary and schedule a 30-min blameless sync tomorrow to decide permanent thresholds
Maya Patel: thanks everyone — please add any missed obs to the incident ticket. if burn creeps >1.5x again we trigger full postmortem
oncall-bot: page acknowledged by Maya Patel at 2142223340
summary: Coordination thread for a transient SLO burn on api-gateway: live mitigation (pool restart), temporary mute, proposal to implement multi-window alerting to reduce paging noise, dashboard and runbook follow-ups.
